_doc: Lender programs by credit tier (#365). `buyRate` is the LENDER's cost of money — what the store buys the paper at — NOT what the customer pays. The customer's rate is `buyRate + markup`, and the dealer keeps a share of the discounted spread as finance reserve (DealEngine.computeReserve). `markupCapPts` is the maximum rate markup that lender allows in points of APR; subprime programs cap tighter, which is why D is the thinnest. There are deliberately NO lender flats: a flat is a second pricing rule the player can neither see nor move (grill I2). Magnitudes here are placeholders owed to a #286-class calibration pass (grill I9).
